summary: Application for turning drawing revision packages into reviewable change evidence and client-facing deliverables, with CloudHammer_v2 as the active revision-cloud detection/eval/training-policy subsystem.

commands.name: serve-local
commands.purpose: Run the browser review surface locally.
commands.expected: Flask serves the app at http://127.0.0.1:5000.

commands.name: serve-private-handoff
commands.purpose: Run the private client handoff app behind the existing Cloudflare Access route after required environment variables are configured.
commands.expected: Waitress serves ScopeLedger at http://127.0.0.1:5000 for Cloudflare Tunnel exposure at https://ledger.nezcoupe.net.
commands.safety: private handoff mode; requires secrets and Cloudflare Access controls

commands.name: process-check
commands.purpose: Check local ScopeLedger backend, port, Windows service, and cloudflared process state.
commands.expected: Prints ScopeLedger backend processes, port 5000 listeners, matching services, and cloudflared tunnel processes.

commands.name: process-start
commands.purpose: Start the local ScopeLedger backend from the repo virtualenv.
commands.expected: Starts python -m backend serve --host 127.0.0.1 --port 5000 and writes backend logs under logs/.

commands.name: process-stop
commands.purpose: Stop local ScopeLedger backend processes rooted in this repo.
commands.expected: Stops matching backend processes and prints updated status.

commands.name: reset-projects
commands.purpose: Clear app project registrations without deleting project workspaces or source packages.
commands.expected: Reports cleared app project registrations and the registry path.

commands.name: fast-release-smoke
commands.purpose: Run the fast app handoff smoke suite without live CloudHammer/GPT processing.

services.name: scopeledger-backend
services.role: Flask/Waitress web app for project intake, Populate, review, and export surfaces.

infrastructureDependencies.name: Cloudflare Tunnel
infrastructureDependencies.notes: Existing tunnel nez-dev-projects maps ledger.nezcoupe.net to http://localhost:5000 for the private handoff path.

notes: Provisional Command Center V1 manifest; revisit after the final schema is implemented.
Category front-row is source-grounded from the active private client handoff priority.
Status active-client-handoff is source-grounded from roadmap/product/deployment docs but should be reviewed if Command Center later defines a fixed status vocabulary.
workspacePath and openPathOverride are intentionally null because default repository-path open behavior is sufficient.
Cloudflare Tunnel is modeled as shared infrastructure, not as a project-owned service.
